questions.stem: Which is a limitation of the simple particle model?

options.text: It only works for solids, not liquids or gases
It cannot explain why gases can be compressed
It does not show the forces between particles or the internal structure of atoms
It shows particles as being different sizes in different states

questions.explanation: The simple particle model has several limitations: particles are shown as solid spheres without internal structure, the forces between particles are not shown, all particles look the same regardless of type, and energy is not visible. Despite these limitations, it is very useful for explaining the basic properties of matter.
